title: A Survey on Trustworthy LLM Agents- Threats and Countermeasures
full_text_basis: Complete paper reviewed including Introduction/Fig.1/Table 1; Sections 2.1-2.3; Sections 3.1-3.3; Appendix A trust-dimension definitions; Appendix B comprehensive taxonomy
scope_rationale: The paper explicitly decomposes agent trust by intrinsic/extrinsic modules, attack-defense-evaluation roles, and safety/privacy/truthfulness/fairness/robustness. This directly fills the trust-dimension distinction raised for Cluster D and supports the manuscript's security/governance synthesis. It remains broad agent/MAS work and does not operationalize extraction-specific provenance or field integrity.
